description: Which places are good, or fair, for an activity in a month, as the site's activity pages say it: hiking (dry days of 10–27 °C), the beach and sea (warm dry days, a warm and calm sea), skiing (deep snow on the ski area's own slopes while its lifts run) or the northern lights (long dark nights under the auroral oval; cloud is not counted, so a good month is no forecast). The most visited first, each with the figure its month was decided on, and the activity's rules and sources in the site's own words. Without a month, how many places are good and fair in each month of the year. A place under travel advice is never listed.

activity.description: hiking, beach (the beach and sea), skiing or northern-lights.

limit.description: At most this many places, the most visited first.

month.description: A month: 1 to 12, or its name ("December", "dec"). Optional: without it, each month's count.

name: activities
title: Activities by month
